messages:
Olivia: FYI customer PixlHealth (acct PH-447) asked for a 3x token quota bump for scheduled inference jobs. Their traffic spiked overnight and auto-ratebot flagged it. Can we do a fraud screen before approving? They say it's a production ramp for a new feature. Attached sample usage and recent invoice.

infra-bot: ratebot flagged increase for PH-447 — risk_score=0.33, recent_new_endpoints=2, anomaly_window=3h

Mike: putting sales context — PixelHealth is on an enterprise trial, billing on file but no prior big bursts. They're asking for a provisional increase for a 2-week ramp, willing to sign an addendum. @Nora can you run the quick check?

Nora: I can do manual review. Need last 30d IP list, any new API keys issued in last 7d, payment method history, and whether they passed KYC. Also share the specific routes (embedding vs generation).

Olivia: sending requested artifacts now: IPs: 34.88.12.9, 34.88.12.10; keys rotated 2026-01-15 (one new key), payment ALREADY on file (card). Routes: mostly "text.generate", some embeddings. Attaching log snippet:
```
2026-02-12T01:12:09Z PH-447 text.generate  tokens=1200  latency=120ms
2026-02-12T01:12:10Z PH-447 embeddings.create tokens=512 latency=85ms
```

Sam: engineering note — current quota config for PH-447: rate_limit=120rps, burst=300rps, monthly_tokens=10M. We can provision a temporary burst window (increase monthly_tokens) but we need fraud signoff. Command to check config: `GET /internal/quotas/PH-447` (returns JSON)

Tess: product perspective — if we approve, criteria: (1) fraud ops clear, (2) we can provide provisional increase with throttles and monitoring, (3) sales signs addendum for temporary uplift & cost acceptance, (4) 48h stability with no error or anomaly spike. Also need to decide whether to make permanent (product decision).

Mike: Sales confirmed they will sign a 2-week addendum. They want 3x tokens effective immediately if risk is low. They can accept phased rollout if ops prefer.

Nora: I ran the manual checks — no known bad IPs, keys look normal but one key was created 2026-01-15 and used at 02:00 UTC which matches the spike. Payment history clean. I'll assign a low-medium risk flag but want to keep tight monitoring. ETA for full write-up: 90m.

infra-bot: provisional increase action: creating temp_uplift ticket #UP-1298, temporarily set monthly_tokens=30M for 72h hold until manual revoke.

Olivia: Next steps I'll do: (a) attach Nora's report when ready, (b) file internal uplift ticket and link to sales addendum, (c) enable extra monitoring alert for error_rate > 1% or latency > 500ms. @Sam can you scope any throttles needed? I'll wait for Nora and then approve provisional uplift.

Sam: will add throttles: soft cap at 250rps with exponential backoff headers returned (429 + Retry-After). Will post the config snippet to the ticket.

Nora: report posted to the ticket. low-medium risk, recommend provisional uplift with monitoring. I'll re-check after 24h.

Tess: thanks — Product notes: label as "needs-observation" and revisit in roadmap grooming if they convert to permanent higher usage. If metrics stable, product will propose permanent increase and pricing re-eval.

Olivia: closing loop — provisional uplift triggered, sales addendum signed, fraud ops cleared provisional. Monitoring alerts in place. Will update thread if anything anomalous. :thumbsup:
